top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock by Katori and Ye is a mature, experimentally validated invention: magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms gave a new route to 1e-18 fractional frequency uncertainty, now underpinning metrology, tests of fundamental physics and a prospective redefinition of the second. The two-laureate allocation matches the invention and its development, and the citation scope is clean and well bounded, so awarding it is preferable to no award.
